text:
Ava: Quick heads-up — planning to enable a rollout for request-coalescing + shared caching (alpha) to 10% prod traffic tomorrow at 09:00 PT. Need sign-off on perf validation, alert thresholds, and rollback plan. Expect ~10–15% token cost savings but watch p95 latency. Who can run a perf replay and own SLO watch?
Sam: Thanks. What's the exact flag name and how are we selecting the canary audience?
Ava: Flag: `ff/serve/coalesce_cache_v2`. Canary selection: 10% random by `user_id` hashing; exclude enterprise customers (tier == "enterprise") and internal-beta orgs.
Diego: I can own SLO hooks and do a synthetic replay against canary. Will run a `wrk` job and a recorded traffic replay from production traces. ETA ~2h.
Priya: I'll prepare the canary runbook and alert thresholds. Proposed triggers to rollback: p95 latency increase > 50ms OR error rate > 0.2% sustained for 5m. Also want to track cost delta (expect reduction >6% as positive).
oncall-bot: deploy-scheduler: scheduled enable of `ff/serve/coalesce_cache_v2` at 2026-04-08T16:00:00Z (09:00 PT).
Sam: I can hold the enable for 30m if Diego wants extra iterations. Also add automated fallback: route traffic to legacy model variant `redwood/model-a@v1.2` if we detect tail degradation.
Jin: I'll add canary tags to traces and ensure the cache hit metric `cache.shared_hit_ratio` and `request.coalesce_rate` land on the main dashboard.
Ava: Diego — paste the exact perf command you plan to run and link the rollout PR so QE can eyeball the changes.
Diego: Running synthetic now. Script: ```
wk -t4 -c200 -d300s -s scripts/replay.lua --latency http://canary.internal/generate
``` PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/4821
Priya: Adding runbook snippet now. Safety net: immediate pause if error rate delta > 0.05% in a 5m sliding window, or if p99 latency jumps > 200ms. I'll pin the playbook to incidents-lib/canary-rollouts.
Sam: LGTM from infra. Confirming audience exclusion: add config `audience.exclude = ["enterprise", "internal-beta"]` to rollout. Also will monitor queue depth on ingress.
Ava: Plan summary — Diego runs perf today; Jin wires traces + dashboard panels; Priya finalizes runbook + alerts; Sam watches infra hooks. If all green, enable at 09:00 PT with oncall monitoring for first 30m. Rollback command: `ffctl disable ff/serve/coalesce_cache_v2 --immediate` and revert traffic weights to 0% for canary cohort. I'll update the rollout doc with the config and add the PR link.
Diego: Perf numbers so far: p95 +8ms, p99 +12ms, error rate steady at 0.03%, `cache.shared_hit_ratio` ~38%. Posting detailed csv in the PR.
Priya: Sounds safe to me. I'll set the automatic rollback threshold at early-warning p95 > 80ms or error rate > 0.2%.
Sam: :thumbsup: I'll keep infra on standby. If anyone wants to delay, notify me by 08:30 PT.
Ava: Great — thanks everyone. I'll post the final rollout note in #eng-runtime and update the schedule in the deploy board.
Jin: Added traces and a short trace sample to the PR. Dashboards show the coalesce metrics under `Serving / Canary / coalesce_cache_v2`.
Ava: Awesome. If anything odd pops in the 30m after enable, we stop and rollback. Otherwise we'll ramp to 50% in the next window.
Sam: Noted. Good luck.
Priya: Uploading runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/ops/canary-coalesce-v2 (draft).
Ava: :raised_hands: Closing here — will ping again when we're go for enable.
